## Simplilearn video frames

These two small frames come from **Simplilearn**, [Most Asked 30 Generative AI Interview Questions 2026](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j5FU7kOGrsU), video ID `j5FU7kOGrsU`. They are included beside commentary comparing the slides with this repository’s original explanations.

| File | Approximate position | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [RAG architecture frame](simplilearn/rag-architecture-20m00s.jpg) | [20:00](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j5FU7kOGrsU&t=1200s) | Compare ingestion and query paths, then discuss controls omitted by a simple overview. |
| [LoRA frame](simplilearn/lora-26m00s.jpg) | [26:00](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j5FU7kOGrsU&t=1560s) | Connect the full-tuning/adapter contrast to dimensions and trainable parameter counts. |

**Acquired:** 2026-10-11, from YouTube’s public preview storyboards. Each image is one complete 320 × 180 tile, extracted without annotations, resizing, or removing branding. The timing comes from the advertised 10-second preview interval: tile 120 and tile 156. The full video and slide deck are not redistributed.
